title: FIFA Statutes 2024 edition (official PDF)
supported_statement: REUSE (SHA re-verified). Congress decides admission (Art. 10); membership requires current confederation membership (Art. 11.2); provisional membership is a confederation-level status short of FIFA membership (Art. 22(g)).

title: FIFA Financial Report 2018 (member association list with affiliation years; editorial deadline 31 December 2018)
supported_statement: REUSE (production-registered; SHA re-verified). Official list of all 211 member associations with affiliation years, including first-admission years retained across successions (e.g. China PR 1931/1980; Czech Republic 1907/1994). The register contains no entry for any of the 112 labels assessed under policy P3 in this batch.
limitations: Year-level; the register does not preserve spells of members expelled before 2018 (e.g. South Africa appears only as 1992), so absence alone has a theoretical expulsion hole - covered by policy leg (a) searches and the exception channel.

title: FIFA Council in 2024 - Annual Report 2024 governance section (official page)
locator: Page text: the 2024 report 'was distributed to all 211 Member Associations and submitted to the 74th FIFA Congress in Bangkok, Thailand, for final approval'
supported_statement: Official FIFA page confirming FIFA had 211 member associations in 2024 (the governance report was distributed to all 211 MAs and submitted to the 74th Congress).
limitations: Confirms the 211 count in 2024; combined with the 2018 register (211) and the 2016 Kosovo/Gibraltar admissions (latest admissions found), supports no admissions 2018-2024; an admit-then-expel event within 2018-2024 preserving the count is not excluded by this page alone.

title: 66th FIFA Congress Zurich 2016 - Kosovo and Gibraltar admitted (production-registered evidence)
locator: Congress 13 May 2016; Kosovo and Gibraltar admitted (production register file admission_events.json)
supported_statement: REUSE of the production-registered admission event: Kosovo and Gibraltar were admitted at the 66th Congress on 13 May 2016 - the latest admissions found in any examined source before 2024.
limitations: Production-registered evidence reused as-is; no 2018-2024 admission events were found in examined sources.
